blurb: Summit Helicopters offers helicopter maintenance, repair, overhaul, and refurbishment services as a FAA Part 145 Repair Station and FAA Part 135 Air Carrier. They operate a fleet of helicopters including Hiller UH-12ET Soloy’s, Bell 206B’s, 206L’s, and 205A-1++’s for various missions such as aerial inspection, power line patrol, construction, fire suppression, and external load flights. The company is employee owned and based in Salem, Virginia.
